close_reason: fixed: inMailboxOtherThan HashSet built once before email loop; email_matches_condition accepts pre-built excluded_set parameter
description: email_matches_condition (tests/common/mod.rs:1743) builds a HashSet<&Id> from the inMailboxOtherThan exclusion list on every email evaluated in a query scan. For a query over N emails with an exclusion list of k entries this is O(N * k) allocations plus O(k) hash-table insertions per email. The set should be built once before the per-email loop (same pattern already used correctly for the submission_matches_condition identity_ids check). At test scale (16 emails) this is harmless, but the pattern would be copied into any real backend that reuses this filter logic.
title: inMailboxOtherThan HashSet rebuilt per email in query loop
